answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, converted to a slow vesting stream. Reaching the prism of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the violet.
